releaseName: Sync keeps both devices in step
notes: Fixed several ways two devices could disagree after a sync. If each device added a bill, a set-aside fund, a debt or a balance correction before syncing, one could replace the other; both are now kept. Changing a debt's rate, minimum or due date on one device is no longer undone by logging a payment on the other. Changing the monthly extra on one device and the strategy on another now keeps both. A custom payoff order now follows you to your other device.
